title: [Decision] the ADR corpus still declares pathlessLineCitations:false after #13556's class was emptied — turn the ratchet on, and what about the two dev-server ports that block it?
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` 执行席 2(座位帖 #18549,会话 `session_01JbZnqu8bt6YqfJsr9vaFb3`)⏱️ x, discharging the **H52** patrol row on card **#18932**.

⚠️ **Why a new card and ⛔ not a re-hung label on #18932.** H52's own remedy orders it: a question raised while EXECUTING a ruling the card already carries is a RESIDUAL, and re-hanging `needs-user-decision` on the executing card would leave the inbox unable to say WHICH question is open, and would take the question's only visibility away when that card closes. ⇒ the question moves here, linked back.

## The question

#13556's class removal emptied `docs/adr/**` of the path-less L-pin spelling — PR #19022 (card #18932) closes the last six — **but the ADR corpus still declares `pathlessLineCitations: false`**, so nothing stops the class regrowing there silently, exactly as those six regrew after #13556.

**Turn the declaration on?**

- **A. Leave it off.** Costs nothing today; the class can regrow unseen.
- **B. Turn it on in a follow-up that FIRST settles the measured blocker** — the two dev-server ports at `docs/adr/0047-object-ui-run-modes.md` lines 48-49, which the shared `pathlessLineCitations` grammar would read as line citations — by porting the negative controls `scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` already pins for its own ports, status codes, URLs and clock times.
- **C. Turn it on and hand authors the maintainer-only anchor-exempt marker for the two ports.**

⭐ The executing dev recommended **B**, and its reason is measurable rather than aesthetic: the blocker is real and already re-measured (#18925: 17 findings across 6 records, 2 of them those ports), and the negative-control solution **already exists in a sibling corpus**, so B is porting rather than inventing. Its stated objection to C is that it hands every author a red they cannot clear themselves.

⛔ **This seat does not grade the options.** Turning a corpus-wide ratchet on is a floor decision.

## ⚠️ A SECOND question, adjacent and ⛔ NOT the same one

The same path-less L-pin shape lives **outside** `docs/adr/**`: `docs/audits/2026-08-partial-retirement-annotation-signal.md` (6 hits) and `docs/launch-readiness.md` (3 hits). Does #13556's class removal reach them?

⚠️ **This one is not ready for a ruling, and saying so is the honest state.** The dev measured those two files **only as light-on controls** and did not sample whether their pointers have rotted — so there is **no evidence in either direction**, and #18932 itself recorded that corpora outside `docs/adr/**` were NOT measured. ⇒ the first act here is a **measurement**, ⛔ not a decision. Recorded here so it is not lost; ⛔ it should not be folded into the A/B/C above, which is a different subject with a different first act.

## Provenance and limits

- Both questions come verbatim in substance from the `os-dev` report on card #18932 (comment `5729740372`). ⛔ **This seat re-ran none of those measurements** — they are relayed and attributed, and the numbers above (17 findings / 6 records / 6 hits / 3 hits / lines 48-49) are the dev's readings, not this seat's.
- Linked: **#18932** (the card that carries the ruling this fell out of) · **#13556** (the class removal) · **#18925** (the re-measurement) · PR **#19022** (the delivery, a governed-surface PR awaiting `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`).
